jsonld.description: Massage and skin care studio in Clearwater, FL, run by Alice Lange, LMT: deep tissue, effleurage, trigger point and couples massage.

parrafo.es: Un estudio de masaje en Clearwater donde Alice Lange, LMT, adapta cada sesión a lo que tu cuerpo necesita: tejido profundo, effleurage o puntos gatillo, en un espacio tranquilo pensado para que te relajes de verdad.
parrafo.en: A massage studio in Clearwater where Alice Lange, LMT, tailors every session to what your body needs: deep tissue, effleurage or trigger point work, in a calm space made for real relaxation.

parrafo_1.es: Massage and Skin Care Solutions es el estudio de Alice Lange, LMT, en Clearwater. Sus clientes la describen como una maestra en su oficio: sabe combinar técnicas de effleurage con trabajo de puntos gatillo según lo que cada cuerpo necesita.
parrafo_1.en: Massage and Skin Care Solutions is Alice Lange's studio in Clearwater, LMT. Her clients describe her as a master of her craft: she knows how to combine effleurage with trigger point work based on what each body needs.

parrafo_2.es: Varios clientes llevan años viniendo con dolores crónicos de espalda y cuello, y destacan su energía calmada y su atención personalizada en cada sesión, incluidos los masajes en pareja.
parrafo_2.en: Several clients have been coming for years with chronic back and neck pain, and they point to her calm energy and personalized attention in every session, including couples massages.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué dolor o tensión quieres tratar y agendamos tu cita por teléfono.

texto.en: Alice identifies where the tension is and picks the right technique for your body.

texto.es: Tejido profundo, effleurage o puntos gatillo, siempre a tu ritmo y en un ambiente relajado.
texto.en: Deep tissue, effleurage or trigger point work, always at your pace in a relaxed setting.

texto.es: Sales con la tensión liberada y un plan de sesiones si decides seguir el tratamiento.

texto.es: Trabajo enfocado en liberar nudos y tensión acumulada, el más pedido por clientes con dolor crónico de espalda y cuello.

texto.es: Presión localizada sobre los puntos de tensión más específicos, para quienes necesitan trabajo más preciso.
texto.en: Targeted pressure on the most specific tension points, for clients who need more precise work.

texto.es: Dos sesiones al mismo tiempo, ideal para una fecha especial o simplemente para relajarse juntos.
texto.en: Two sessions at the same time, perfect for a special date or just relaxing together.

items.quote: Absolute best massage I have ever had in my life, from Lora Gibbs. I am a licensed massage therapist myself so I am very picky, but Lora knows how to incorporate a variety of techniques to achieve your desired outcome, and she also has genuinely positive energy that can be felt during the session.

Alice offers the perfect massage for everyone's needs, whether it be soft and gentle strokes or trigger points worked out. My husband and I went for couples massages for Valentine's Day and he was so impressed!

I started going to Massage and Skin Care Solutions for massage therapy with Alice Lange, LMT about three years ago to help alleviate stubborn low back pain. Her office environment is laid back and relaxing, which helps reduce stress and tension the minute you walk through the door.
